profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer @ Mercado Libre
profile.summary:
My main professional experience is Backend Software Engineering ☕👨‍💻

Up to this point in my career I have:
- collaborated on cross-discipline teams, working alongside areas such as Product, QA, BA, UX/UI, Data. This has driven me to have a broad perspective and to approach Software Development grounded in understanding business and user needs.
- participated in the entire SDLC, programming in the context of digital product building, and on central features such as: Accounts and Deposits (Homebanking), Shopping Cart and Search (E-Commerce).
- worked on enterprise-level applications with massive user traffic, gaining experience in practices like: resilience, scalability, and observability; concurrency and asynchrony; persistence strategies and query optimization; event-driven architecture; production deployment strategies; reactive programming.
- applied the use of LLMs, agentic IDEs, and MCPs to be more productive in the development cycle.
- integrated IA into my coding workflow to be more efficent, making use of: agentic CLI tools, agentic IDEs, and MCPs.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Java
positions.description:
Desarrollo backend Java, equipos Shopping Cart y Search.
Trabajo sobre aplicaciones de tráfico masivo de cara a usuarios. Esto demanda aplicar patrones de escalabilidad, resiliencia y observabilidad. Utilizo la IA para potenciar mi workflow de trabajo.

- Java, Micronaut, Spring, Javalin, MongoDB, Event-driven architecture, Reactive Programming, Datadog, Grafana, Claude Code

positions.title: Software Developer | Java
positions.description:
Participé de la construcción y migración de herramientas internas para la operación de servicios de auxilio vial.

- Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Hibernate/JPA, SQL, PostGIS, Redis, Docker, GitLab CI, React

positions.title: Software Developer | Java
positions.description: I work as a Java Developer for Openbank, a digital bank from Spain and part of Grupo Santander. Some of the the tools I work with are Java 8, Java 11, Spring Boot, JUnit, Mockito, Swagger, Harness, AWS Cloudwatch, Lombok, Feign.

positions.title: Software Developer | Java, React
positions.description:
I worked developing a mobile app for Efectivo Sí, a finance company from Argentina. Tech stack:
- React Native, TypeScript, Redux.
- Java 11, Spring Boot, Mockito, Docker.
- Scrum, Gitlab, Android Studio, Postman, Firebase.
